text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: tomorrow morning 10:30 were expecting a courier with an awkwardly-shaped demo crate (says "BIKE RACK"). Need lobby logistics - short list: badge kiosk, overflow seating, and package drop.

Liam (Front Desk): Copy. Kiosk on the right is free. Printer is fine today but Ill keep the backup sticker rolls by the desk.

Zoe: If the crates big, can we use the delivery alcove and tag it in the package tracker as "demo: bike crate"? That way the demo team knows where to find it.

Maya (People Ops): Yes please tag. Could someone also measure the alcove width so courier knows if it fits through the door? Quick photo works too.

Raj: Im near the lobby at 9:45 — happy to grab measurements and a pic.

Liam (Front Desk): Sweet. Ill reserve Locker 5 from 10:15-12:30 as backup. If it doesnt fit, well put it on the rolling rack and leave a note in the calendar.

checkin-bot: Reminder: kiosk auto-update tonight at 2:00am. Please ensure its plugged in.

Zoe: Also, quick poll: do folks want to move the two beanbags from lounge to meeting corner for visiting guests? Reply with A for yes, B for no.

Maya (People Ops): A if youre okay carrying them upstairs, B if not. :grin:

Raj: A (I can help).

Liam (Front Desk): B (beanbags are in high demand at lunch). Could we instead bring two folding chairs?

Zoe: Folding chairs it is. Raj and I will do chairs + pic of alcove at 9:50.

Maya (People Ops): Bonus ask: enable selfie capture on kiosk so visitor badges have photos. Liam, can you toggle that at 10:20?

Liam (Front Desk): Yep, will enable selfie capture and test a dummy badge.

Zoe: Heads-up: courier sometimes asks concierge to sign. If that happens, please take a photo of the crate front and note courier name. We had a mix-up last month.

Maya (People Ops): Good call. Also mark fragile if the crate has stickers.

Raj: Uploaded photo of alcove to #photos: [attachment: alcove_width.jpg]. Looks like 32in clearance.

Liam (Front Desk): 32in should fit most crates but ask courier to orient vertically. Ill put the sign on the desk: "BIKE RACK DELIVERY 10:30 - ring bell" :bell:

Zoe: Thanks team. Who wants to greet at 10:35? No pressure, just front-of-house hello.

Maya (People Ops): Ill take 10:35-10:50.

Liam (Front Desk): Ill handle check-in after the greeting and print badges.

checkin-bot: Log: kiosk selfie mode enabled by Liam at 10:22 (simulated).

Maya (People Ops): Perfect — Ill update the calendar with these notes and tag demo team. If anything changes, ping here. Thanks! :white_check_mark:

Zoe: Also, small meme to reduce stress: [attachment: tiny-bike-hero.png] :bike:
